title.en: Admin Lists: create Browsers option list with ordered items
title.uk: Admin Lists: створити список Browsers з упорядкованими елементами

description.en: Admin → Lists creates reusable option lists (label, key, colour, description, active/deprecated).
description.uk: Admin → Lists creates reusable option lists (label, key, colour, description, active/deprecated).

precondition.en: Signed in as system admin. Open Admin via gear → Admin settings.
precondition.uk: Signed in as system admin. Open Admin via gear → Admin settings.

action.en: Open Admin → Lists; create list key=browsers name=Browsers; add Chrome/Firefox/Safari/Edge; reorder.
action.uk: Open Admin → Lists; create list key=browsers name=Browsers; add Chrome/Firefox/Safari/Edge; reorder.

expected_result.en: List saved; items ordered; colour/description optional; deprecate instead of hard-delete when in use.
expected_result.uk: List saved; items ordered; colour/description optional; deprecate instead of hard-delete when in use.

title.en: Admin Custom fields: checkbox and multi-select on test cases
title.uk: Admin Custom fields: checkbox і multi-select на тест-кейсах

description.en: Admin → Custom fields defines Automated? (checkbox) and Browsers (multi-select from list) with All projects scope.
description.uk: Admin → Custom fields defines Automated? (checkbox) and Browsers (multi-select from list) with All projects scope.

action.en: Create fields automated (checkbox) and browsers (multi_select → Browsers list), scope All projects, show in list/filters.
action.uk: Create fields automated (checkbox) and browsers (multi_select → Browsers list), scope All projects, show in list/filters.

expected_result.en: Fields appear on case create/edit/detail for every project; editors can set values; only Admin manages definitions.
expected_result.uk: Fields appear on case create/edit/detail for every project; editors can set values; only Admin manages definitions.

title.en: Custom field scope selected projects and hide-keep values
title.uk: Scope кастомного поля Selected projects і hide-keep значень

description.en: Narrowing scope hides the field but retains stored values with a warning.
description.uk: Narrowing scope hides the field but retains stored values with a warning.

precondition.en: Field exists with values on two projects.
precondition.uk: Field exists with values on two projects.

action.en: Change scope from All to Selected (one project) with acknowledge; open the other project's case.
action.uk: Change scope from All to Selected (one project) with acknowledge; open the other project's case.

expected_result.en: Warning shown; field hidden on excluded project; previously stored value still in DB/history.
expected_result.uk: Warning shown; field hidden on excluded project; previously stored value still in DB/history.

title.en: Custom fields on requirements and bulk edit
title.uk: Кастомні поля на вимогах і bulk edit

description.en: Entity=requirement or both; case list columns/filters; bulk set values.
description.uk: Entity=requirement or both; case list columns/filters; bulk set values.

precondition.en: Field with entity=both or requirement; cases selected on Cases page.
precondition.uk: Field with entity=both or requirement; cases selected on Cases page.

action.en: Edit requirement custom fields; filter cases by Automated?; bulk-set Browsers on selected cases.
action.uk: Edit requirement custom fields; filter cases by Automated?; bulk-set Browsers on selected cases.

expected_result.en: Values persist; list columns/filters honour show_in_list / show_in_filters.
expected_result.uk: Values persist; list columns/filters honour show_in_list / show_in_filters.

description.en: Admin → Export/import and `vulyk-api config export|import` produce versioned JSON/YAML without secrets.
description.uk: Admin → Export/import and `vulyk-api config export|import` produce versioned JSON/YAML without secrets.

precondition.en: System admin; lists and custom fields seeded.
precondition.uk: System admin; lists and custom fields seeded.

action.en: Export all projects JSON; import with dry-run preview; apply merge by key.
action.uk: Export all projects JSON; import with dry-run preview; apply merge by key.

expected_result.en: Bundle includes lists, fields, project settings; secrets omitted; preview shows create/update; import idempotent.
expected_result.uk: Bundle includes lists, fields, project settings; secrets omitted; preview shows create/update; import idempotent.
